entries.subject: L’LORRI mosaic
entries.finding: The retained label for lor_0798443290_04598_00035_1x1_sci_03 was examined: processing_level is Partially Processed and conversion_to_physical_units is false, despite a general description calling it calibrated science data. The selected pair therefore remains relative DN/s after bias/smear/flat processing, with source illumination. The 0.008 s exposure belongs to this frame; the paired 0.005 s exposure is handled separately. No absolute-reflectance qualification follows from the generic product description.

entries.subject: Shape
entries.finding: [Lucy/DLR DSK](https://naif.jpl.nasa.gov/pub/naif/pds/pds4/lucy/lucy_spice/spice_kernels/dsk/lcy_donj_k548_iso20m_v10.bds), `lcy_donj_k548_iso20m_v10.bds`. Original OBJ built 4 June 2025; DSK generated 24 June. [Coordinate description](https://pds-smallbodies.astro.umd.edu/holdings/pds4-lucy.mission:document-v2.0/Donaldjohanson_Coordinate_System_Description_v1.pdf) and [Marchi et al. 2026](https://www2.boulder.swri.edu/~bottke/Reprints/Marchi_2026_Science.aec0503._DJ_Asteroid.pdf) define its interpretation.

entries.subject: Source-surface Elevation on the contact shape
entries.finding: The earlier radial approach was withheld because 729 original face centroids differ from the first surface on their ray by up to 400.124 m, despite an 8,192-direction scan finding no second intersections. The 13 September audit identified the existing closest-source-point path as unqualified for this body. The 14 September qualification now includes Elevation on the unchanged 800-face mesh. Independent full-source checks retain the outer patch at source facet 487421 at 942.724 m above the 2,405.325 m sphere, rather than the first-ray value 400.124 m lower. The 56 m transfer limit withholds 13,810 of 5,778,049 triangle-interior texels (0.239%), shown as gray grid patches; those counts are not observed area. Existing photographs remain byte-identical. Headless DPR 1/2, mobile, rotation and lighting checks pass. Stereo constrains about 40% of the source shape; reconstructed unseen terrain remains reconstructed. Fine triangle boundaries remain visible at close zoom.
